label: JSON Validator
description: Validates JavaScript values against JSON Schema definitions.

validate.description: Validates a value against a JSON Schema and returns the validation result without throwing for schema validation errors.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: JSON Schema definition used for validation.

returns.description: Validation result containing a valid flag and validation errors.

valid.description: Whether the value satisfies the schema.

assert.description: Validates a value against a JSON Schema. Throws an Error containing validation errors in its cause when invalid. Returns the original value when valid.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: JSON Schema definition used for validation.
